name: A Little Lily Princess
source: Newly arrived at a boarding school in Victorian England, Sara Crewe uses her love of books and storytelling to build new relationships. But what happens to a fairy-tale princess when she loses everything?
translation: 刚来到维多利亚时代英国寄宿学校的萨拉·克鲁，利用对书籍与讲故事的热爱建立新的关系。然而，当童话公主失去一切后，会发生什么？
